title: chore: bump version to 2.2.0 in flake.nix with new hash
body:
I am using NixOS and neovim, and depends on the version consistency between mcp-hub.nvim and mcp-hub. 

This pr just upgrade the flake version and npm deps hash to match the new v2.20 mcp-hub.

```
❯ mcp-hub --version
2.2.0
```

title: ci: add workflow to update flake version and hash
body:
Add GitHub Actions workflow that automatically updates version and npmDepsHash in flake.nix based on package.json version.

The workflow:
- Extracts version from package.json
- Updates version in flake.nix
- Calculates new npmDepsHash using prefetch-npm-deps
- Updates hash in flake.nix
- Optionally creates a PR with the changes

This automation helps maintain consistency between package.json and flake.nix versions.

closes: #7

title: Feat/nix compatibility
body:
## Flakes support for mcp-hub server
This pull request introduces Nix compatibility to the project.

Changes:
- package.json
  - remove prepare script linking to build script so ìnstall`and `build`are separate steps (good practice but can be discarded)
  - Updated dependencies to fix `npm i` warnings
    - @vitest/coverage-v8 from ^3.0.5 to ^3.0.8
    - vitest from ^3.0.5 to ^3.0.8
- .gitignore: added result which is a symlink to the build output of nix (local development)
- flake.lock: added for nix usage.
- flake.nix: added for nix usage
